name: career-pivot-roadmap
description:
Builds a dated, milestone-based career pivot roadmap covering skill gap analysis,
credential requirements, portfolio plan, networking targets, and timeline. Produces
a complete action plan document with specific dates and measurable milestones.
Use when the user wants to change careers, transition to a new field, plan a career
switch, or build a roadmap for entering a different industry.
Do NOT use for job search strategy within the same field (use job-search-strategy),
resume rewriting for a career change (use career-change-resume), or skill learning
plans for professional development without a career change (use skill-gap-analysis).
